content: security-crypto: entire library (EncryptedSharedPreferences/EncryptedFile) DEPRECATED in 1.1.0-alpha07 (April 2025) after ~4 years in alpha, never stable. Known issues: AEADBadTagException crashes when Keystore key invalidated, MasterKey not invalidated on lock-screen changes as documented, plaintext strings leak in heap dumps, Tink friction. Google recommends DataStore; community fork ed-george/encrypted-shared-preferences exists.
